summary: Mergeable PR with minor issues related to documentation and code style.

issues.description: Code style inconsistency: The use of both string formatting and re.escape() for regex pattern creation is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase.
Missing docstring update: The change in _get_edited_object_pks() method does not have a corresponding update in the docstring.
Lack of additional test cases: Although the automated tests pass, it would be beneficial to add more test cases to ensure the fix is comprehensive and does not introduce any regressions.
